name: Ardent
body:
Within the Shattered Worlds exists an infinite combination of fundamental concepts: Chaos, order, life, death, creation, and destruction; to name a few. Philosophically, these concepts ebb and flow against each other, the balance of which forms reality for the creatures within. Ardents are the psionic disciples of these vast concepts, meditating on their existence and the balance they create within everything. By drawing on these aspects of reality, an ardent can shape it to her needs.

Role: Ardents have many potential builds that they can grow into as they gain experience. Depending on the mantles they choose, an ardent could wade into melee or stay back and manifest psionic power.

Alignment: Any.

Hit Die: d8.

Starting Wealth: 3d6 × 10 gp (average 107 gp.)

Class Skills

The ardent’s class skills are Autohypnosis (Wis), Climb (Str), Craft (Int), Fly (Dex), Knowledge (All) (Int), Linguistics (Int), Profession (Wis), Spellcraft (Int), and Swim (Str). Each of an ardent’s mantles grants her an additional class skill.

Skill Ranks per Level: 4 + Int modifier.

Table: Ardent

Class Features

All of the following are class features of the ardent.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

An ardent is proficient with all simple weapons, light and medium armor, and shields (but not tower shields).

Power Points

An ardent’s ability to manifest powers is limited by the power points she has available. Her base daily allotment of power points is given on Table: Ardent. In addition, she receives bonus power points per day if she has a high Wisdom score. Her ancestry or heritage might also provide bonus power points per day, as might certain feats and items.

Powers Known

Ardents create their class power list from the mantles they choose as they gain levels in the ardent class. An ardent begins play knowing two ardent powers chosen from the list of powers granted by her mantles. Each time she achieves a new level, the ardent can choose an additional power from that list.

An ardent can manifest any power that has a power point cost equal to or lower than her manifester level.

The total number of powers an ardent can manifest in a day is limited only by her daily power points.

An ardent simply knows her powers; they are ingrained in her mind. She does not need to prepare them (in the way that some spellcasters prepare their spells), though she must get a good night’s sleep each day to regain all her spent power points.

The Difficulty Class for saving throws against ardent powers is 10 + the power’s level + the ardent’s Wisdom modifier

Maximum Power Level Known: To learn or manifest a power, an ardent must have a Wisdom score of at least 10 + the power’s level.

Talents (Sp)

An ardent begins play with one 0-level power from each of her mantles. Each time she gains a new mantle, she also chooses one of that mantle’s talents and adds them to her list. Any time she could retrain a power known, the ardent can choose instead to retrain which talent one of her mantles grants.

Expanded Knowledge

If an ardent gains a power by taking the Expanded Knowledge feat, that power may be chosen from any power list, even those of other classes. If the feat is used to take a power which is associated with a psionic mantle, the bonus power may be excluded from calculations of primary and secondary mantle power totals whenever doing so is advantageous.

Psionic Mantles

At 1st level, an ardent chooses two mantles that represent the fundamental concepts of her existence. Once these choices are made, they cannot be changed. Each mantle grants the ardent the following benefits.

A class skill if she doesn’t have it already.
Access to the power list associated with that mantle.
Access to each mantle’s focal ability. She chooses one focal ability from her mantles at 1st level, and gains the other at 3rd level. From 6th level on, she gains the focal ability from each of her mantles when she selects them.
A selection of insights from which she can choose when she gains that feature beginning at 3rd level.

An ardent can select any mantle she wants, even those that are diametrically opposed to each other, such as creation and destruction. Ardents that represent such concepts might live to keep them in balance, or they might express themselves as a living contradiction of reality.

As an ardent experiences reality, her existence becomes more complex, and her understanding of fundamental concepts grows. At 6th level, and every 3 levels thereafter, the ardent chooses an additional mantle that helps define her existence, to a maximum of 7 mantles at 18th level.

This allows an ardent seeking a true balance of reality within herself to select a total of three powers from each of her mantles by 20th level.

A selection of 26 mantles can be found at the end of this section.

Complex Existence (Ex)

An ardent’s existence is a complex tangle of fundamental concepts that shape who she is and how she interacts with reality.

At 2nd level, this allows an ardent to add her Wisdom bonus (if any) to her AC and CMD when unarmored, not using a shield, unencumbered, and conscious.

If she is wearing armor or using a shield, she instead adds half her Wisdom bonus to her AC (minimum 0).

Beginning at 4th level, the ardent’s existence grows more complex, granting her a +1 bonus to her AC and CMD. This bonus increases by 1 for every 4 ardent levels thereafter (up to a maximum of +5 at 20th level).

These bonuses to AC apply even against touch attacks and when the ardent is flat-footed. She loses these bonuses when she is immobilized or helpless.

Ardent levels stack with monk levels, and levels in any class that gains a similar AC bonus (such as shifters) when determining the increased bonus the ardent gains to AC. The bonuses themselves, as well as the added ability score modifier, do not stack.

Mantle Insights

At 3rd level, an ardent gains greater insight into her mantles in the form of a special ability she can choose from among them.

She gains additional insights at 10th, 14th, and 18th level.

Greater and Superior Insights: In order to select a greater or superior insight within a mantle, the ardent must have all previous insights granted by that mantle first.

Retraining Insights: When she gains an ardent level, the ardent can choose to learn a new insight for which she meets any prerequisites or requirements in place of one she already knows.

In effect, the ardent loses the old insight in exchange for the new one. She may swap only a single insight at any given level, and must choose whether or not to swap the insight at the same time that she gains new powers known for the level. Alternatively, she can spend one day of down time meditating on a new insight, two days on a greater insight, or three days on a superior insight.

These days need not be consecutive, but must be completed in one-day increments.

Attuned Skills (Ex)

At 5th level, an ardent becomes a master of her mantles’ associated skills. She can take 10 on skill checks when using her mantles’ associated skills in which she has ranks. An ardent can choose not to take 10 and can instead roll normally. In addition, once per day, the ardent can take 20 on any mantle’s associated skill check as a standard action. She can use this ability one additional time per day for every six levels she possesses beyond 5th, to a maximum of three times per day at 17th level.

Improved Attuned Skill (Ex)

Beginning at 7th level, when an ardent makes a skill check using one of her mantles’ associated skills, she can expend her psionic focus to roll 1d6 and add that value to her check. She can use this after rolling the check, but before learning the result, and she can use it even when taking 10 or 20.

At 13th level, the ardent rolls 2d4 instead, and at 19th level, she rolls 2d6.

Swift Insight (Ex)

At 15th level, an ardent can glean insight from reality more quickly. She can retrain any mantle insight by spending 1 minute meditating on the new insight for which she meets any prerequisites or requirements.

Perfect Insight (Ex)

At 20th level, an ardent selects a number of her mantles’ insights up to her Wisdom modifier. While she maintains her psionic focus, she can spend one full round meditating to swap one of the insights she knows for one of the chosen insights.

While meditating in this way, the ardent can take no other actions, but retains her AC bonus from complex existence (unless she loses that bonus for another reason). If she has evasion or any other ability that doesn’t function while she is helpless, she retains those abilities as well, unless she would lose them for another reason.

Favored Class Bonuses
Any: Choose one mantle. Add +1/2 to the ardent’s manifester level when manifesting a power from that mantle.
Dwarf or Elf: Add +1/3 power known from the ardent’s class power list. This power must be at least one level below the highest power level the ardent can manifest.
Human or Halfling: Gain 1/6 of a new mantle insight (max 1).
Gnome, or Xeph: Add +1/2 to the xeph’s saving throw against psychoportation powers or effects.
Maenad or Orc: Gain a +1/3 bonus on critical hit confirmation rolls made while maintaining psionic focus (maximum bonus of +5). This bonus does not stack with those gained through Critical Focus and similar effects.
Ardent Mantles

The following mantles are available to all ardents. When you gain a mantle, you automatically gain its focal ability and the associated skill as a class skill. The DC of any saves required by mantle abilities is: 10 + 1/2 your ardent level + your Wisdom modifier

When choosing insight abilities, you cannot select a greater insight ability without first selecting the insight ability, and you cannot select a superior insight ability without first selecting the greater insight ability.

Communication

The concept of communication is a fundamental aspect of reality because it allows the expression of needs and desires.

Communication exists on basic, rudimentary principles that can be shared between anything, even plants and vermin. Your understanding of this allows you to find simple channels of communication that you can share.

Associated Skill: Perform

Telepathic Link (Su, Focal Ability)

While you maintain your psionic focus, you can use a standard action to form a telepathic link with a number of willing, intelligent creatures up to your Wisdom modifier within line of sight. Once the link is established, it persists while you maintain your psionic focus, to a maximum distance of 25 feet plus 5 feet per 2 ardent levels. While the link persists, connected creatures can send messages of up to 10 words using a missive effect.

When you roll initiative, you can expend your psionic focus and allow each linked creature to choose which initiative to take from among those rolled. If on your first turn, you meditate to regain your psionic focus, you don’t lose your telepathic link.

Anything that would prevent you from meditating on your first turn immediately breaks the link.

Broaden Communication (Ex, Insight)

You and creatures sharing your telepathic link also share languages while the link persists. If a creature with an Intelligence score of 1 or 2 is part of your link, it understands those languages, and can pass on basic communication of its own, but gains no greater reasoning capacity; merely a temporarily enhanced vocabulary.

Empowered Link (Ex, Greater Insight)

You can use powers with a range of touch on willing creatures connected through your telepathic link, and the maximum range of your link becomes 100 feet plus 10 feet per ardent level.

Hive Mind (Su, Superior Insight)

Once you establish your telepathic link, it persists while you maintain your psionic focus out to anywhere on the same plane, and you can communicate with it using a mind link effect. If your link is broken for any reason, you can reestablish it with the same creatures any time within 1 hour per ardent level, as long as those creatures are on the same plane as you.

Mantle Powers

0th—empathy, missive; 1st—mindlink, telempathic projection; 2nd—mass missive, natural linguist; 3rd—battlesense, strike as one; 4th—alienation, correspond; 5th—metaconcert; 6th—aura alteration; 7th—divert teleport; 8th—ability as one; 9th—psychoportation circle

Conflict

Conflict is inevitable with so many different views of reality; so many different contradictory, yet fundamental aspects. Once you understand that, you begin to embody the conflict between psionic gifts and physical prowess, blending the two into one form.

Associated Skill: Survival

Breaker of Conflict (Ex, Focal Ability)

While maintaining your psionic focus, you can use a swift action to designate a weapon you wield as your conflict weapon for up to 1 minute. Your conflict weapon always benefits from any combat feats you possess that can apply to it.

As a swift action (or as part of the same action as designating your conflict weapon), you can expend your psionic focus and grant your conflict weapon a +1 enhancement bonus for the duration. For every four ardent levels beyond 1st, the weapon gains another +1 enhancement bonus, to a maximum of +5 at 17th level. These bonuses can be added to the weapon, stacking with existing weapon enhancement to a maximum of +5. Multiple uses of this ability do not stack with themselves.

At 5th level, these bonuses can be used to add any of the following weapon properties: dancing, flaming, flaming burst, frost, icy burst, keen, shock, shocking burst, speed, or vorpal.

Ardent Warrior (Ex, Insight)

You can select combat feats as a fighter of your ardent level, but they only function with your conflict weapon.

You are also treated as having Weapon Focus with your conflict weapon, even if you don’t have already that feat. For each of the following feats you already possess, you gain the next feat in order once you meet its level requirements instead. Weapon Focus, Weapon Specialization, Greater Weapon Focus, Greater Weapon Specialization.

Ardent Hero (Ex, Greater Insight)

When you threaten a critical hit with your conflict weapon, you can expend your psionic focus to confirm it. If you also have the Critical Focus feat or a similar bonus when you do this, add that bonus to your conflict weapon’s damage before multiplying it instead.

Ardent Champion (Sp, Superior Insight)

While you maintain your psionic focus, you can expend enough power points to manifest a 5th-level or lower psionic power as a free action at the start of your turn. If you do, increase your base attack bonus by that amount, to a maximum of your level. This lasts for 1 round per ardent level.

Mantle Powers

0th—lesser fortify, trick shot; 1st—metaphysical weapon, offensive precognition; 2nd—psionic lion’s charge, repositioning strike; 3rd—graft weapon, sharpened edge; 4th—battle transformation, zealous fury; 5th—barrage; 6th—technique as one; 7th—fate of one; 8th—form of doom; 9th—last stand

Consumption

The mantle of consumption has always existed as an extension of the endless hunger that lurks at the edge of reality; waiting for an opening. When the first vampire was created, the hunger took it as an avatar of consumption, and it has remained ever since.

Your understanding of this allows you to consume the existence of others even as you try not to fall victim to the hunger yourself.

Associated Skill: Sleight of Hand

Consuming Strikes (Su, Focal Ability)

While you maintain your psionic focus, damage you deal with melee weapons and natural attacks restores 1 hit point to you for every 5 damage you deal. For this purpose, damage from stored spells, poison, or other effects on a weapon don’t contribute to the hit points you regain. You can’t regain hit points from creatures with 4 or more total Hit Dice less than you, as their existence lacks the complexity you crave. Once you have regained at least 2 hit points per ardent level in one day, this ability ceases to function until you rest for at least 8 hours (the hp you regain from the damage that puts you over this limit isn’t reduced, but you can’t regain more after).

As a standard action, you can expend your psionic focus and cause each creature within 30 feet of you to take damage equal to your ardent level (Fort negates). You regain hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier + half the total damage dealt in this way.

Vitalizing Strikes (Ex, Insight)

When you use consuming strikes, any hit points you would regain over your maximum hit point total become temporary hit points that last for 1 minute. These temporary hit points stack up to a maximum of your level (minimum 4).

Consume Capability (Su, Greater Insight)

When you expend your psionic focus to use consuming strikes as a standard action, you can choose one creature that fails its save. That creature also takes 1d4 damage to one ability score of your choice, and you gain an equal morale bonus to the same ability score that lasts for 1 minute. This damage can’t reduce a creature’s ability score below 1.

Endless Hunger (Su, Superior Insight)

As a swift action, you can open yourself to the endless hunger at the edge of reality. You gain a +4 morale bonus to Strength and Constitution, as well as a +2 morale bonus on Will saves, but you can’t use any Charisma-, Dexterity-, or Intelligence-based skills (except Acrobatics, Fly, Intimidate, and Ride) or any ability that requires patience or concentration. This morale bonus stacks with other morale bonuses, but not itself, to a maximum of +6 (or +8 at 20th level).

In addition, your consuming strakes have no limit on hit points regained while using endless hunger, but the limit applies normally when it ends.

Your endless hunger lasts for a number of rounds up to 4 + your ardent level each day, and you can end it as a free action.

You do not have to use the rounds consecutively. It counts as the barbarian’s rage class feature, except as noted here.

You can select this superior insight twice.

Mantle Powers

0th—disruptive touch, hinder; 1st—absorb weapon, bite of the wolf; 2nd—feat leech, strength of my enemy; 3rd—claws of the vampire, vampiric blade; 4th—hidden body, power leech; 5th—leech field; 6th—co-opt concentration; 7th—decerebrate; 8th—mind seed; 9th—assimiliate

Corruption and Madness

Where thinking minds exist, corruption and madness dwell.

Everything in reality is always one poor decision away from both.

Once you understand that, you can find those threads; pull them.

Unravel reality around you and remake it as you see fit.

Associated Skill: Disguise

Near-Incorruptible (Ex, Focal Ability)

You gain a +1 bonus on saves against mind-affecting effects.

This bonus increases by +1 at 5th level, and every 4 levels thereafter, to a maximum of +5 at 17th level.

When you attempt a saving throw against a mind-affecting effect, you can expend your psionic focus as a free action to roll that save twice and choose either result. If both save attempts fail, you regain your psionic focus.

Minor Crisis (Su, Insight)

When you manifest a power from your ardent power list, you can spend 2 additional power points and cause one of the power’s targets to become confused for 1 round as it questions its own morality (corruption) or reality (madness). A successful Will save, separate from any associated with the power itself, negates this; as does the application of spells or manifestations such as greater restoration, heal, limited wish, miracle, or wish cast by a creature with a higher caster level than your manifester level.

On a failed save, the creature treats its Wisdom (madness) or Charisma (corruption) score as 1 point lower for the purpose of gaining a corruption or madness. This effect stacks and lasts for 1 day. The duration returns to 1 day with each failed save. Once a creature’s effective Wisdom or Charisma meets or exceeds its current ability score, it permanently gains a madness or a corruption, respectively. This is a mind-affecting effect.

Incorruptible Aura (Su, Greater Insight)

You are immune to mind-affecting effects, unless you choose to let them affect you. Each ally within 10 feet of you gains a +4 morale bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects.

This ability functions only while you are conscious, not if you are unconscious or dead.

Major Crisis (Su, Superior Insight)

When you expend your psionic focus against a mind-affecting effect and succeed, you can turn the effect back on its creator, even if that creature is normally immune to its own effect. This also applies the effect of your minor crisis to the creature as if you spent 2 additional power points.

Mantle Powers

0th—sense poison, telepathic lash; 1st—corrosive aura, unearthly terror; 2nd—compelling voice, true terror; 3rd—endorphin surge, expose weakness; 4th—fear cascade, personality parasite; 5th—parasitic possession; 6th—crystallize; 7th—psychosis; 8th—form of doom; 9th—microcosm

Creation

Everything in existence was created; whether by circumstance, some cosmic event, or a greater being that itself was created at some point. Once you understand that, you begin to see the building blocks of reality. You learn how to manipulate them to create something where nothing previously existed.

Associated Skill: Disable Device

Creative Spark (Su, Focal Ability)

While you maintain your psionic focus, you increase your effective manifester level by one when manifesting powers from the creation subdiscipline. This increase becomes two at 8th level, and three at 15th level. The effective increase in manifester level increases the number of power points you can expend on a single creation power manifestation, as well as increasing all manifester level-dependent effects, such as range, duration, and overcoming power resistance. This otherwise functions as and does not stack with the Overchannel psionic feat.

In addition, you gain a bonus on all Craft checks equal to 1/2 your ardent level.

Enhanced Constructs (Ex, Insight)

When you manifest astral construct, your construct gains an additional menu option of your choice. It must meet any requirements for that menu option.

Enduring Creations (Ex, Greater Insight)

You double the duration of creation powers you manifest. Once per day, when you manifest a creation power with a duration of at least 1 hour, you can choose to make its duration permanent (D). The manifestation retains an obviously magical aura, and you can only have one permanent manifestation at any given time.

Ectoplasmic Protection (Su, Superior Insight)

The hardness of any objects you carry is increased by 10, and you increase any natural armor bonus you may have by your Wisdom modifier (If you don’t have a natural armor bonus, it is effectively 0).

Mantle Powers

0th—ectoplasmic trinket, psionic repair; 1st—astral construct, ectoplasmic creation; 2nd—concealing amorpha, reconstruction; 3rd—greater concealing amorpha, ectoplasmic grapnel; 4th—modify matter, wall of ectoplasm; 5th—major ectoplasmic creation; 6th—greater modify matter; 7th—mass ectoplasmic cocoon; 8th—matter manipulation; 9th—true creation

Death

The psychopomps exist to maintain the balance of life and death. They abhor the undead, and align themselves with any who will aid in their efforts to hold a clear division between this life and the next. Once you understand that, you begin to see the black and white of existence. Like the psychopomps, you are an arbiter of balance out to ensure souls reach their true destination.

Associated Skill: Stealth

Lay to Rest (Su, Focal Ability)

Your weapons and natural attacks gain the disruption weapon special ability, even if they don’t meet the requirements. As a move action, you can expend your psionic focus to grant one of your natural attacks or a weapon you wield the bane weapon special ability for one minute. Choose the affected creature type each time you use this ability. These abilities do not count against your weapon’s limit, and you do not require a masterwork weapon or a +1 enhancement bonus to apply them.

Speak with Dead (Sp, Insight)

You can cast speak with dead as a spell-like ability once per day.

You can select this insight multiple times.

Dying Breaths (Sp, Greater Insight)

You increase your effective manifester level by one whenever you are within 30 feet of a dying creature. The effective increase in manifester level increases the number of power points you can expend on a single creation power manifestation, as well as increasing all manifester level-dependent effects, such as range, duration, and overcoming power resistance.

You can also manifest death knell as a 2nd-level psionic power.

You can augment that power in one or both of the following ways:

For every 4 additional power points you spend, increase the enhancement bonus to Strength by +2, to a maximum of +6.
For every 2 additional power points you spend, including for the above augment, increase the temporary hp gained by 1d8.
In Death, All Things are Equal (Su, Superior Insight)

When you critically hit a creature chosen as your bane with lay to rest, you can force it to attempt a saving throw against your disruption as though it were undead. If it fails, the target is reduced to –1 hit points and begins dying. Abilities like ferocity still function against this effect. You can do this a number of times per day up to your Wisdom modifier. This is a death effect.

Mantle Powers

0th—disruptive touch, sicken body; 1st—collapse, prevenom weapon; 2nd—dissolving touch, mental disruption; 3rd—crisis of breath, psionic blast; 4th—deadly fear, death urge; 5th—psychic crush; 6th—breath of the black dragon; 7th—crisis of life; 8th—recall death; 9th—assimilate

Deception

Everybody lies; of that you’re sure. They might believe they do so for a good cause, or that a white lie won’t harm anyone; but that doesn’t make those statements less false. Once you understand that, you can take advantage of what others are willing to believe to improve your own status and quality of life.

Associated Skill: Bluff

New Identity (Ex, Focal Ability)

You gain a second identity. This functions as the vigilante’s dual identity feature. As a free action, you can expend your psionic focus to gain the benefits of seamless guise for up to 3 + your ardent level rounds per day. These rounds need not be used consecutively.

Glamorous (Su, Insight)

While you maintain your psionic focus, you can use a standard action to glamer any gear you have, including weapons, armor, and shields. This functions as the glamered special ability. You can change any number of glamers in this way with one use.

Expending your psionic focus doesn’t end the glamer; it just makes you unable to change it.

Split Personality (Ex, Greater Insight)

You no longer need to expend your psionic focus to use seamless guise. You also gain the quick change vigilante social talent.

Shared Immersion (Sp, Superior Insight)

While you maintain your psionic focus, you can manifest the following spell effects as psionic powers of the same level.

hallucinatory terrain (4th), persistent image (5th), veil (6th), project image (7th), screen (8th), resplendent mansion (9th)

Mantle Powers

0th—conceal thoughts, create sound; 1st—disable, empathic connection; 2nd—cloud mind, everyman; 3rd—escape detection, false sensory input; 4th—incite passion, memory modification; 5th—dream message; 6th—mind switch; 7th—personal barred mind; 8th—barred mind; 9th—true mind switch

Dedication

[Source]

Traditional ardents can only ever gain a total of 4 insights they spread across 7 different mantles, giving them a very narrow subset of abilities they can gain. Mantle dedication alters that by allowing an ardent to give up gaining new mantles, and instead gain two new insights from the mantles she already possesses.

This allows the ardent to gain both of her existing mantles’ insights at 6th level, as well as the greater insight for one of them.

She still cannot gain superior mantles before 14th level, however, so she will still end her progression with at least 4 total mantles, but can have each of her mantles insights and either of these two options.

Up to four greater insights, and two superior insights.
Up to three greater insights, and three superior insights.

When using mantle dedication, an ardent rarely needs to retrain her insights, if at all. Instead, ardents with this variant usually continue to retrain their insights in their downtime, and gain the following features.

Greater Mantle Dedication (Ex)

At 15th level, the ardent can choose one focal ability her mantles grant that requires her to maintain her psionic focus. She no longer needs to maintain her psionic focus to gain that focal ability’s benefits.

This ability replaces swift insight.

Superior Mantle Dedication (Ex)

At 20th level, the ardent can either choose a second focal ability to use without maintaining her psionic focus, or she can choose the same mantle again. If she does, any abilities that require the ardent to expend her psionic focus can be used as a standard action without expending her focus. If the ability is usually activated as an immediate action, the ardent can use it without expending her focus, but she then loses her next standard action instead of her swift action.

This ability replaces perfect insight.

Destruction

Over time, all things can be destroyed in some way. Seemingly indestructible objects and creatures can be removed from reality, locked away and forgotten about. Even intangible things, such as one’s social image or standing, can be destroyed in an instant.

Once you understand this, you find the tears in reality that allow you to bring about its destruction.

Associated Skill: Intimidate

Destruction (Su, Focal Ability)

You gain Improved Unarmed Strike as a bonus feat. When you hit a creature or an object with your unarmed strike, you can use an immediate action to expend your psionic focus and attempt to destroy the target. A creature affected by your destruction takes 1d3 Constitution damage (Fort negates, constructs can be affected and take Strength damage instead). When a creature fails its save, you can choose to maximize the Constitution damage as a free action. If you do, you can’t use this ability again for 1 hour.

You must decide before rolling the damage.

When you use destruction against an object, you ignore an amount of that object’s hardness up to your Wisdom modifier or your ardent level, whichever is higher.

Charge with Destruction (Ex, Insight)

You can store your destruction in a weapon you wield, as if the weapon had the spell storing special ability. If you critically hit a creature with your weapon or unarmed strike while storing destruction in this way, the damage is automatically maximized (the target still gets its saving throw).

Elements

The elements are the building blocks for most of reality. It is from the elements that worlds are created, and by the elements that they are usually destroyed. Your understanding of this taps you into the interwoven fabric of elements in reality, from which you can draw elemental power.

This can be done as part of the full-round action required to regain your psionic focus. Earth—If you choose earth twice, you gain tremorsense out to 60 feet and ignore difficult terrain related to earth, sand, or stone.
Fire—If you choose fire twice, creatures immune to fire are treated as having fire resistance 30 against your fire effects instead.

Fate is the understanding that all things happen for a reason.

We can control our realities to an extent, but there are events and situations predestined to occur that we can only avoid for so long. Pain and Suffering

The potential for pain and suffering exist within all members of reality. Some draw pleasure from them, either as the creator or the recipient. Once you understand that, you can reflect on both, managing your own feelings and drawing them out of others.

Associated Skill: Heal

Shared Pain (Su, Focal Ability)

While you maintain your psionic focus, you can use a standard action to form an empathic link with a single living creature you are aware of within 30 feet of you. While the link persists, you can use an immediate action to deal damage to yourself or the other creature up to 1/2 your ardent level (minimum 1 damage). If you do, the other member of your link regains hit points equal to the damage dealt. As a standard action, you can expend your psionic focus and deal damage equal to twice your ardent level instead, then the link breaks.

Unwilling creatures can attempt a Will save against your shared pain every time you attempt to deal damage to them through your empathic link. A creature that succeeds on its save breaks the link and can’t be targeted by your shared pain again for 24 hours.

Bloodletting (Ex, Insight)

Whenever you threaten a creature with a critical hit with a piercing or slashing weapon (regardless of whether you confirm the critical hit or not), you cause that creature to bleed, making it take 1 point of bleed damage at the beginning of each round thereafter. This bleed damage increases by 1 for every additional pain and suffering insight you possess.

Bi-Directional Pain (Ex, Greater Insight)

Willing creature sharing your empathic link can use their own immediate actions for pain and suffering, but only to take damage and heal you. Any member of your empathic link can choose to take damage up to your ardent level instead. An unwilling creature that fails its save against your shared pain is staggered for 1 round.

Pain Network (Ex, Superior Insight)

When you use shared pain, you can form an empathic link with a number of creatures up to your Wisdom modifier within 60 feet of you instead. Once the link is established, it persists to a maximum distance of 400 feet plus 40 feet per ardent level. As a standard action, you can expend your psionic focus and deal damage to one creature that shares your empathic link equal to 1/2 your ardent level x the number of other creatures that share your empathic link. If you do, each of those creatures regains its own share of those hit points. Excess hit points gained in this way by a single creature are not redistributed to other creatures; they are lost.

Unwilling creatures that save against your shared pain can be targeted again after 1d4 rounds.

Physical Power

The body is necessary for physical beings to exist within reality.

It anchors them, provides various stimuli, and allows them to better express other concepts; but it comes at a price. Once you understand that, you begin to discover ways to push yourself further, harder, faster. Fighting against exhaustion, weakness, and even death by building your physical stamina and power.

Associated Skill: Acrobatics

Psionic Mutation (Su, Focal Ability)

While you maintain your psionic bonus, you can meditate for one hour on the presence of endorphins and other hormones within your body. At the end of that hour, Choose Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. As a move action, you can expend your psionic focus and gain a +4 alchemical bonus to the selected ability score for 10 minutes per ardent level. In addition, while the mutation is in effect, you take a –2 penalty to one of your mental ability scores. If you enhanced your Strength, you take a penalty to your Intelligence. If you enhance your Dexterity, you take a penalty to your Wisdom. If you enhance your Constitution, you take a penalty to your Charisma.

Once you have used psionic mutation, you must meditate for another hour before you can use it again.

You can select the alchemist’s greater mutagen discovery as a greater insight, and the grand mutagen discovery as a superior insight. The benefits of those mutagens apply to your psionic mutation.

Powerful Build (Ex, Insight)

Your physical stature increases by half again your normal size. This lets you function in many ways as if you were one size category larger. Your space and reach are unchanged, but you can still be affected by powers, abilities, and spells that change your size category.

You gain a +1 size bonus on combat maneuver checks and to your CMD.
You are considered to be one size larger when determining whether a creature’s special attacks based on size (such as grab or swallow whole) can affect you.
You can use weapons designed for a creature one size larger without penalty.
Peak Physical Form (Ex, Greater Insight)

You have greater control over your stamina, gait, and general balance. Increase your all of your speeds by 10 feet. If you don’t have a climb speed or a swim speed, you gain one at 10 feet.

Nigh-Invulnerable (Ex, Superior Insight)

You gain DR 3/–. If you select this again, it increases to DR 5/–.

The Planes

The planes exist as an extension of reality, a million puzzle pieces that come together in one perfect formation. That the two can sometimes overlap is a marvel, creating planar events, beings, and objects. Once you understand that, your senses open and seek those subtle differences in reality so that you can control them.

Associated Skill: Handle Animal

Plane-Touched(Ex, Focal Ability)

When you select this mantle, you gain physical traits that mark you as extraplanar, such as monochomatic eyes, heightened features, or other minor effects. Your creature type counts as outsider with the native subtype when it would benefit you. Creatures trying to affect you based on your type or subtype (such as a ranger’s favored enemy) must be able to target both your original type and outsiders with the native subtype to affect you, unless you choose to allow the effect to happen as a free action.

As a swift action, you can expend your psionic focus to grant a number of willing creatures up to your Wisdom modifier the benefits of this focal ability. This is a supernatural, polymorph effect for those creatures, and it lasts up to 1 minute per ardent level. A creature benefiting from plane-touched in this way can dismiss it as a free action.

Detect Planar Entity (Su, Insight)

At will, you can detect the presence of summoned creatures and items, ethereal creatures, and outsiders without the native subtype. This functions as detect magic, but only for the things mentioned here.

As a move action, you can concentrate on a single item or individual creature within 60 feet to determine if it meets the criteria above, learning any remaining duration it has (if any), or the strength of its aura as if having studied it for 3 rounds. While focusing on one individual or object, you do not detect other planar entities within range.

Detect Planar Event (Su, Greater Insight)

Your ability to detect planar entities can now also detect the use of teleportation magic or psionic psychoportation as a creature leaves or just before it arrives. If you are within 60 feet of where a creature will teleport or appear after teleporting, you become aware of its presence immediately as long as you are not focusing on an individual or object and can use a free action to call attention to it. Creatures that have recently teleported and areas where such an effect has occurred leave their aura to detect and potentially track using Knowledge (planes) in place of Survival (all other effects that benefit tracking, such as the ranger’s track and swift tracker class features apply normally).

While you maintain your psionic focus, you can manifest the following spell effects as psionic powers of the same level. dimension door (4th), dismissal (5th), getaway (6th), banishment (7th), dimensional lock (8th), gate (9th.

Repose

Rest is key to all forms of recovery. One’s body cannot hold up to constant rigors and stress. Eventually, it will simply give up.

Once you understand that, you can more accurately track your body’s needs and ability to persist for longer before you give it a break.

Associated Skill: Sense Motive

Conscious Effort (Ex, Focal Ability)

You add your Wisdom score to your Constitution score when determining how long you can hold your breath. You also do not need sleep, but must remain at ease for the normal amount of time to regain spells and other abilities that require rest (although you can perform light activity, such as reading or keeping watch).

Once you go without sleep for a total of seven consecutive nights, you are exhausted until you sleep for at least 8 hours.

Finally, before you attempt a saving throw, you can expend your psionic focus as an immediate action to roll that save twice and take either result. If the effect requiring the save deals any type of damage, you take no damage on a successful save, and only half damage on a failed save.

Serene Presence (Ex, Insight)

Your body has optimized its control of various mental and physical illnesses. Choose one type of affliction. You are immune to afflictions of that type, including supernatural and magical afflictions.

You can select this insight multiple times.

Passive Existence (Su, Greater Insight)

Your serene presence becomes nearly impossible to detect with magic. You gain a constant nondetection effect.

Perfect Repose (Su, Superior Insight)

You are no longer required to breathe or eat, but can do so if it would grant you a benefit, such as consuming a potion.

You need only sleep 2 hours per day to gain the benefit of 8 hours of sleep (including with conscious effort). This allows you to recover your power points after only 2 hours, but does not allow you to recover them more than once per day.

Time

Time is a construct, an arbitrary measure created by mortal cultures. Once you understand that, you begin to see the flaws in it. The idea that time moves ever-forward, yet affects some more quickly than others allows you to manipulate it to your advantage.

Associated Skill: Sleight of Hand

Nick of Time (Su, Focal Ability)

You get periodic flashes, seconds into the future, that don’t allow you to avoid danger, but can help you adapt to it quickly.

While maintaining your psionic focus, you gain a bonus on initiative checks equal to 2 + 1 for every 3 ardent levels you possess beyond 1st (4th, 7th, and so on), to a maximum of +8 at 19th level.

When you would take damage or suffer from a negative effect, you can expend your psionic focus as an immediate action to instead delay it until the end of your next turn. On your turn, you can use a move action to delay it again. You can do this for a number of rounds up to your Wisdom modifier. When you finally take the damage or suffer from the effect, it occurs exactly as it would have when you were first affected by it and can’t be resisted or reduced by effects that occurred after. This allows you to prepare to treat or prepare for the effect, but not to negate it.

Temporal Awareness (Su, Insight)

You can always act in the surprise round even if you fail a Perception check to notice foes, but you are still considered flat-footed until you take an action.

Time is a River (Sp, Greater Insight)

Once per day, as a standard action, you can create a haste or slow effect. This functions as the spell of the same name, and your caster level with the spell is equal to your ardent level.

You can select this greater insight multiple times.

Time is On My Side (Su, Superior Insight)

You gain the benefit of greater age resistance while maintaining your psionic focus. You also gain the shapeshifter subtype. As a standard action, you can alter your physical appearance to look like you’re an adult, middle-aged, old, or venerable. This otherwise counts as the effects of wizened appearance if you become older, or youthful appearance if you become younger.
